name: basque_country_official_full_predictor_design
status: official Synth example predictor transformation; declared six-year post scalar

provenance.original_study: Abadie and Gardeazabal (2003), Economic Costs of Conflict: A Case Study of the Basque Country
provenance.transformation: official package example's 13 post-combination predictors, rounded to six decimal places with R 4.6.1

design.predictor_definition: five regular 1964-1969 means after combining the two highest schooling categories, plus the eight special predictors in the Synth package example
design.post_summary_note: declared scalar for this robustness analysis; the package example plots the full 1955-1997 path
design.predictor_scaling_note: the official Synth row standardization is positive and only reparameterizes unrestricted continuous V
